rules_reasons: high: changes CI or the gates (1 file)
medium: matches no triage rule (1 file)
reasons: `.github/rulesets/tags.json` adds a `bypass_actors` entry (actor_id 5, RepositoryRole, bypass_mode always), which weakens the release-tags ruleset.
`justfile` `verify-release` changes the release supply-chain verification (new tag, ancestor and `--source-digest` checks), so a mistake there could let bad releases pass.
The `release-tags` ruleset gains a `creation` rule, and the ADR and gates docs describe new trust boundaries, so this change alters what the release gates check.
